title: Write test vectors for article IPLD schema — root node, MIME node, metadata
description: Produce fixed test vectors (known input bytes -> known expected CIDs and DAG-CBOR output) for: a plain text/plain article (no MIME), a quoted-printable encoded text article, a multipart/alternative article (text/plain + text/html), and an article with a binary part (binary flag). Vectors must be derived independently (not from the code under test) — use a reference IPLD/DAG-CBOR library (Python ipld-cbor or js-dag-cbor) to compute expected values.
notes: Size: M. Depends on Issue H (root node builder).
